@deskBarMenu.description: Screen-reader label of the brand button at the left of the window's title bar, which opens the app menu. {app} is the product name, Epic Cash Desktop.

@deskBarLock.description: App menu item (title bar) and keyboard-shortcuts row: lock the open wallet. The shortcut is shown beside it.

@deskBarShortcuts.description: App menu item and the title of the dialog that lists the keyboard shortcuts.

@deskBarAbout.description: App menu item: opens Settings › About. {app} is the product name, Epic Cash Desktop.

@deskBarQuit.description: App menu item and keyboard-shortcuts row: lock the wallet and close the app.

@deskBarWalletsHere.description: Small heading over the list of wallets in the title bar's wallet menu.

@deskBarAddWallet.description: Wallet menu item (title bar): opens Settings › All wallets, where a wallet is added.

@deskBarWalletSettings.description: Wallet menu item (title bar): opens the open wallet's settings.

@deskBarStatus.description: Tooltip of the node / Epicbox / Tor status icons in the title bar; a click lists them.

@deskBarMinimise.description: Window button tooltip: minimise the window.

@deskBarMaximise.description: Window button tooltip: maximise the window.

@deskBarRestore.description: Window button tooltip on a maximised window: back to its earlier size.

@deskBarClose.description: Window button tooltip: close the app (the wallet locks first).

@deskBarSendRunningTitle.description: Dialog title when the window is closed (close button, Alt+F4, Quit) while a payment is being sent.

deskBarSendRunningBody: Closing now would leave the payment's outcome unknown. The wallet can close by itself once the send has finished.

@deskBarSendRunningBody.description: Dialog text under 'A send is in progress'. There is deliberately no way to close at once.

@deskBarKeepOpen.description: Main button of the 'A send is in progress' dialog: do not close.

@deskBarCloseAfterSend.description: Second button of the 'A send is in progress' dialog: close the app by itself once the send is done.

@deskBarClosesAfterSend.description: Toast after 'Close when it finishes', and the close button's tooltip until then.

@deskBarClosing.description: Shown over the window while the app locks the wallet and stops the local node before it closes.

@deskBarKeyBack.description: Keyboard-shortcuts row: go back one step (Alt+Left).

@deskBarKeyClose.description: Keyboard-shortcuts row: Esc closes the top-most menu or dialog.

@deskBarKeySubmit.description: Keyboard-shortcuts row: Ctrl+Enter runs the main button of the form being filled in.

@deskBarKeyList.description: Keyboard-shortcuts row: the ? key opens this list.

@deskBarCopyBuild.description: App menu item (title bar): copies the running build (version, rebuild, commit, core, system) for a bug report.

@deskBarBuildCopied.description: Toast after the build info was copied; the copied line shows under it.

deskBarBuildTip: Version {version}, commit {commit}. Click copies the build info.

@deskBarBuildTip.description: Tooltip of the small build label under the brand in the title bar. {version} e.g. 26.10.16, {commit} a short git commit like 810de1e.

deskBarBuildTipRebuild: Version {version}, rebuild {rebuild}, commit {commit}. Click copies the build info.

@deskBarBuildTipRebuild.description: As deskBarBuildTip, for a rebuild of the same version. {rebuild} is e.g. r2.

deskBarBuildTipDev: Version {version}. A development build. Click copies the build info.

@deskBarBuildTipDev.description: As deskBarBuildTip, for a development build without a commit.

@deskBarKeyMenu.description: Keyboard-shortcuts row: F10 opens the app menu in the title bar.
